4. Suggested Build Sequence Build left to right, facing the front: left return, left side, front, right side (with the entry), right return. 1 Check the truck. Before leaving, check the truck against the materials form to make sure all the material was loaded, including the 2 spare sheets. 2 Arrive and secure the area. Sign in with centre management. Set up barrier tape and the bollard around the work zone. Lay the dust suppression. 3 Set out the hoarding limit. From the building, mark the 1600 left return and the 1600 right return. Snap the 5600 left side and the 5600 right side at 90 degrees to them, then the 10200 front joining the two corners. 4 Mark the entry. On the right side, measure 2800 from the front corner and mark a 1600 opening (2800 to 4400); one full 1200 sheet follows it before the right return. 5 Stand the Titan uprights. 24 uprights, each one at a joint between two sheets (never in the middle of a sheet), including one each side of the entry; they are marked on the melamine layout. Plus 10 extra uprights (40% more, for wind on this external site), also with 8 counterweights each; the supervisor decides where they go. Plus 4 spare uprights (10%), not placed on the layout, each with 8 counterweights. 304 counterweights are sent (38 x 8). 6 Frame the walls. Fix the 70 x 45 MGP 10 studs (2.4 m) so every melamine joint lands on a stud. Frame the entry with 2 x 2.4 m and 4 x 2.3 m door studs and a head at 2400. 7 Fix the 2400 sheets. Left return S1, S18b (400, at the corner); left side S2, S3, S4, S5, S18a (800, at the corner); front S6, S7, S8, S9, S10, S11, S12, S13, S19a (600, at the corner); right side left S14, S15, S19b (400, at the corner); right side right S16; right return S17, S20 (400, at the corner). 8 Hang the doors. Two 2340 leaves on 4 hinges, metal plates and deadbolt. Check they close and lock. 9 Finish. White tape on every vertical joint, black skirting tape along the base, screw covers, anti-tampers, 6 warning stickers, paint touch-ups. 10 Hand over. Clean up, remove the barrier, photograph each side, complete the installation certificate and sign INST CHK. 5. Site checks Confirm before fixing anything; update the drawings if any differ. How this price is worked out  Pacific Fair hoardings are charged per lineal metre (lm) under the agreed BSG Commercial Internal Hoarding Schedule of Rates for GPT - Pacific Fair 25-26.  The lineal metres are the full hoarding run, which includes the returns and sides as well as the front: 1,600 + 5,600 + 10,200 + 5,600 + 1,600 = 24,600 mm = 24.6 lm.  The hoarding is 2,400 mm high, so it falls in the up to 2.4 m high band at $220.00 per lm (ex GST). The rate rises with height because taller hoardings need more melamine, more counterweights per upright and more labour to install safely.  The run is above the 10 lm minimum charge, so the actual length is charged.  This hoarding is outdoors, so it is strengthened against wind with 40% more uprights and 8 counterweights per upright. Wind-rated hoardings are priced on application (POA) under the rate card.  24.6 lm x $220.00 = $5,412.00 ex GST, plus GST at 10%. 4. What is included  Supply, delivery, installation and removal of the TITAN free-standing hoarding system.  Structural engineering certification to AS4687 (pre-engineered certified hoarding).  16 mm white melamine boards with white taped joints and black skirting tape along the bottom.  One set of double doors, opening 2340 mm high x 1600 mm wide, with barrel bolt (deadbolt lock provided by Pacific Fair).  Free-standing installation: nothing is fixed to the centre's finishes, so there is no damage and no make-good work when the hoarding is removed.  Hoarding drawing for approval (attached).  Hoarding on site for up to 6 months before further charges apply.
